scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run check && pnpm run build:assets && pnpm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run check && pnpm run build:assets && pnpm run db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
